scripts.dev: node -e "import('child_process').then(({spawn}) => { spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); });"
scripts.start: node -e "import('child_process').then(({spawn}) => { spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'start'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); });"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
